_note: The format of private.json: details for the PDFs you send, never for the public site. The real file is private/private.json on your computer (never committed) or private.json in your private repo. Only `npm run pdf` reads it. Every field is optional; delete the ones you don't use.
address: Street, City, ST 00000 (replaces the city and state on the PDFs; leave it out to keep just the city)
federalDetails: Lines shown under your contact details on the federal version only, like citizenship or veterans' preference
